info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Information Management API
info.description: The Market Information Management API enables businesses to update and refine market data seamlessly. This API allows authorized users to modify existing market information, ensuring real-time accuracy and relevancy. It is primarily designed for financial institutions and market analysts who require up-to-date data to make informed decisions. Typical use cases include adjusting market settings, updating pricing information, and maintaining compliance with market regulations.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific market information resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the provided data complies with the expected format for successful updates.

requestBody.description: This request body updates the market information related to the specified resource. It requires a JSON object that follows the defined schema to modify existing records or properties.
